records.text: An anonymous witness told Owens that Turning Point USA staff removed a poster at Charlie Kirk's Arlington memorial site saying his 'big sister' could figure out what happened.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep a2bZf4fic10)

appearances.snippet: Someone sent me a photo in Arlington that they had made a poster at Charlie's memorial site, one of the many around the country, and they had... ... written on the poster, 'Don't worry, your big sister can also figure out what happened,' and the Turning Point staff removed the poster. Sent me the photos and everything. I don't have it for you today, because we weren't planning on doing a show. And they saw them whispering, and they removed the poster.

verification.notes: The transcript shows Owens saying someone sent her photos and reported that Turning Point USA staff removed the Arlington memorial poster. The witness is anonymous and the referenced photos were not presented in the episode. Current searches found no independently attributable witness, image record, or TPUSA acknowledgment confirming the removal, so the claim remains unverifiable.

links.title: Poster Removal Is Not Assassination Proof
